# agent-pane-dogfood (t-610355)

Isolated fixture for F5 dogfood of the first-party agent pane (layer 2).

1. Point Dev Host at this worktree with this fixture (`--owner grok`).
2. F5 **Tachyon: Dev Host · grok** (or set active to grok).
3. Wait for agent `dogfood` running.
4. Sidebar: eye = integrated terminal; terminal icon = agent pane.
